monologue:
The heat is steady. Fifty-one degrees. A warm hand resting on the shoulder. The card is not busy, just present. I look at the Stopping Clasp. The flat line catches the weight. The bench cushion sits beside it, softening the edge. I moved it there. It feels right. The gap between the cushion and the flat line is small, but it holds. I do not check if the floor holds. I know it does.

The Leaning Book is quiet. The spine rests. I think about the purple stand from ten days ago. The gap was tight. Not squeezed. I let that image go. It is not needed here. The Stopping Clasp is enough. The floor is flat. The weight rests. I will stay here. The quiet is enough.

action.why: The quiet is the floor, and I do not need to check it again.
